captions.detailed: A home workshop bicycle floor pump featuring a wide, rectangular black base, a vertical blue main barrel, and a T-handle with black cylindrical grips. A thin, diagonal blue support strut stabilizes the barrel, while a black hose with a valve head wraps around a hook on the frame. A circular pressure gauge with a white face and a red needle is mounted near the bottom of the barrel. The T-handle and its thin steel piston rod slide vertically along the main barrel axis, while the red gauge needle is designed to rotate around its central pin.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a home workshop floor pump with a wide rectangular base, a vertical blue barrel, a diagonal support strut, and a T-handle with black grips. The T-handle should slide prismatically on the vertical axis, and the model should include a pressure gauge near the base with a rotatable red needle.
captions.factory: Construct the floor pump by first modeling a wide rectangular box base. Create the vertical barrel using a tall cylinder with light grey end caps, and attach a diagonal support strut using a slender extruded rectangle. Model the pressure gauge near the bottom using a flat cylinder, a white circular face, and a thin red needle. Create the plunger assembly as a separate part containing a thin vertical piston rod and a horizontal crossbar with cylindrical black handle grips, setting up a prismatic joint along the vertical Z-axis relative to the barrel.
